jobs.title: Director of Analytics Engineering
jobs.description:
Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

The Team

Data & Analytics is building the DNA of an AI native Scribd, Inc. Bringing together Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and Data Analytics, D&A partners across product, technology, content, and the business to scale intelligence, advance understanding, shape strategy, and turn insight into lasting growth across our four brand portfolio.

Making this ambition real at scale starts with Analytics Engineering. The team transforms fragmented data, inconsistent definitions, and dispersed analytical knowledge into trusted, reusable, production quality data foundations and products that enable intelligence to scale across the company.

In partnership with Engineering, Analytics Engineers ensure critical data is captured, centralized, documented, secured, and governed. The team builds canonical datasets, shared metrics, and semantic layers, together with the quality, observability, lineage, and evaluation systems that make these assets trustworthy. On top of this foundation, Analytics Engineers develop AI agents and analytical tools that bring reliable intelligence directly into the decisions and workflows of teams across the company.

The Role

We’re hiring for a Director, Analytics Engineering to own scaling data for an AI native Scribd, Inc. You will build, scale, and lead a high performing Analytics Engineering team, turning strong individual contributors into a cohesive and highly effective team. This requires more than hiring and developing exceptional talent. It means establishing an operating model that creates structure without unnecessary bureaucracy, fostering culture and community that balances local priorities with the broader success of the company, and creating the technical foundations and standards of excellence that enable everyone to do their best work.

Your leadership philosophy is grounded in service. A leader’s role is to provide clarity, create context, remove obstacles, and help others succeed. You will strengthen team dynamics, ensure great work is recognized, create meaningful career pathways, and help individuals navigate obstacles and opportunities throughout their careers. Durable teams are built by distributing ownership, developing leaders, and creating an environment where people feel trusted, supported, and accountable.

Your pragmatic approach keeps the organization moving forward. Rather than waiting for an ideal end state, you will think in sequences and ask, “What is the right next version?” Communication happens early and often because transparency, thoughtful feedback, and visible decision making build trust and help teams move with confidence.

Your strong strategic judgment is paired with enough proximity to the work to guide technical decisions credibly. You will connect analytics engineering investments to company priorities, communicate tradeoffs clearly to senior leaders, and contribute thoughtfully to decisions about data modeling, architecture, governance, quality, tooling, and developer experience.

The transformation happening through AI is an opportunity to expand what talented teams can accomplish. Agentic coding, AI assisted development and analysis, and automated workflows can increase human judgment, creativity, and impact rather than replace them. You approach these technologies with curiosity and pragmatism, applying them where they create clear and measurable value.

Above all, leadership is about building people and strengthening the discipline they share. Success is reflected in a team that grows more capable, confident, connected, and effective because of your leadership.

The Essentials

10+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence engineering or a related discipline, including 5+ years leading and developing technical teams
Proven track record of building, scaling, and leading high performing teams, turning strong individual contributors into cohesive and highly effective teams that are valued as strategic partners
Depth in building governed, canonical data models and semantic layers, giving core business concepts one authoritative, discoverable definition instead of letting teams reconcile competing sources
Experience designing the data quality, observability, documentation, governance, access control, privacy, lineage, and evaluation systems that ensure data and AI products are reliable, explainable, trustworthy, and safe to operate at scale
Advanced SQL skills and production experience with modern data stack, including AWS, Databricks, Airbyte, Fivetran, Looker, or comparable platforms
Demonstrated ability to lead cross functional data initiatives from strategy through production adoption and measurable business impact
Strong judgment in balancing immediate stakeholder needs with long term investments in reusable data products, platform health, and technical debt reduction
Excellent written and verbal communication with technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior executives

The Nice to Haves

Advanced Python
Experience leading data cleanup efforts and implementing role based access controls and data retention policies to improve data quality, security, and governance
Experience designing and building canonical data models and semantic layers that support financial analysis at scale
Experience leading on call rotations, coordinating incident response, resolving production issues, and driving follow up improvements that strengthen system reliability

At Scribd, Inc., your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location. San Francisco is our highest geographic market in the United States.

In the state of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $202,500 [minimum salary in our lowest geographic market within California] to $268,000 [maximum salary in our highest geographic market within California].

In the United States, outside of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $191,500 [minimum salary in our lowest US geographic market outside of California] to $254,000 [maximum salary in our highest US geographic market outside of California].

In Canada, the reasonably expected salary range is between $177,000 CAD[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market] to $235,000 CAD[maximum salary in our highest geographic market].

We carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to experience; job-related skill sets; relevant education or training; and other business and organizational needs. The salary range listed is for the level at which this job has been scoped. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for a competitive equity ownership, and a comprehensive and generous benefits package.

one of the following cities. This includes surrounding metro areas or locations within a typical commuting distance:

If you apply for a job with Scribd, Inc. or otherwise engage with us in connection with employment (including as an employee, contractor, or other personnel), the personal information we process in that context is subject to our Employee and Applicant Privacy Policy, which is available here .

jobs.title: Director, Digital Marketing & Web Experience
jobs.description:
At Varicent, We’re Not Just Transforming The Sales Performance Management (SPM) Market—we’re Redefining How Organizations Achieve Revenue Success. Our Cutting-edge SaaS Solutions Empower Revenue Leaders Globally To Design Smarter Go-to-market Strategies, Maximize Seller Performance, And Unlock Untapped Potential. Varicent Stands At The Forefront Of Innovation, Celebrated As a Market Leader In The 2025 Forrester Wave Report For SPM, 2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index, Gartner Peer Insights, 2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide, And G2. Our Solutions Are Trusted By a Diverse Range Of Global Industry Leaders Like T-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker And Hundreds More. Here’s Why You’ll Thrive At Varicent

Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide.
Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team.
Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization.
Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment.

Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

The Opportunity

Varicent is seeking a strategic, creative, and data-driven Director, Digital Marketing & Web Experience
to lead our digital growth engine across digital marketing, website strategy and experience, paid media, SEO/AEO/GEO, conversion optimization, and digital performance measurement.

This leader will own the strategy and performance of Varicent’s digital channels, with accountability for their contribution to pipeline and revenue. You’ll shape how prospective customers discover, engage with, and convert through Varicent’s digital experiences while ensuring our investments are measurable, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.

This is a broad functional leadership role that combines strategic ownership with operational fluency. You’ll lead a team and agency ecosystem spanning digital marketing and web experience while partnering closely with Marketing leadership, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Content, Creative, Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Marketing, IT, Finance, and other stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

Digital Marketing Strategy & Leadership

Own Varicent’s digital marketing strategy across paid media, SEO/SEM, website experience, landing pages, conversion optimization, retargeting, and account-based digital programs.
Develop and lead a multi-quarter digital marketing and web roadmap aligned with pipeline, revenue, brand, and customer acquisition goals.
Define the role of digital channels throughout the buyer journey, from awareness and demand creation through conversion, pipeline acceleration, and customer expansion.
Establish priorities, investment areas, operating rhythms, and measurement frameworks for the function.
Identify emerging digital opportunities, buyer behavior shifts, platform changes, competitive trends, and technologies that can improve performance.
Serve as the senior functional leader for digital marketing and web experience across the Marketing organization.

Paid Media, Digital Acquisition & Pipeline

Own strategy and performance across paid digital channels, including Google Ads, LinkedIn, paid social, display, retargeting, review sites, content syndication, programmatic, ABM platforms, and intent-based advertising.
Own paid media budget strategy, channel mix, investment allocation, forecasting, and spend pacing.
Partner with agencies on campaign execution, optimization, reporting, and performance recommendations.
Partner with Demand Generation, Content, and Product Marketing to develop digital programs supporting product, audience, industry, ABM, event, webinar, and pipeline acceleration initiatives.
Lead audience segmentation, targeting, and experimentation across channels, creative, landing pages, forms, CTAs, and conversion paths.
Continuously optimize programs to improve conversion, lead quality, opportunity creation, pipeline contribution, and return on marketing investment.
Ensure digital programs are effectively integrated with marketing automation, CRM, lead routing, scoring, nurture, attribution, and reporting.

Website Strategy & Digital Experience

Own Varicent’s corporate website strategy as a core demand generation, brand, product storytelling, and conversion platform.
Lead the vision for website experience, UX, design, navigation, information architecture, conversion paths, accessibility, and brand consistency in partnership with the Senior Web Developer.
Own the website roadmap and establish effective processes for prioritization, governance, design standards, development coordination, QA, and release management.
Lead the strategy for landing pages, campaign pages, product and industry pages, resource experiences, demo request paths, and event pages.
Partner with Brand, Creative, Content, and Product Marketing to ensure the website clearly communicates Varicent’s value proposition and differentiation.
Drive conversion rate optimization through analytics, heatmaps, behavioral insights, A/B testing, and funnel performance data.
Ensure the website is optimized for search visibility, accessibility, Core Web Vitals, mobile responsiveness, privacy, security, and performance.
Lead major digital experience initiatives, including redesigns, CMS improvements, migrations, personalization programs, and other website transformations.

Organic Search & Discoverability

Own Varicent’s SEO strategy and ensure paid and organic search work together to maximize visibility, efficiency, and conversion.
Partner with the Senior Manager of Digital Marketing to identify keyword opportunities, content gaps, high-intent buyer topics, and organic growth priorities.
Guide technical SEO, content optimization, site architecture, metadata, schema, internal linking, and search-focused website improvements.
Partner with the Senior Web Developer and agencies to resolve technical SEO issues related to indexing, crawlability, redirects, site speed, and page structure.
Establish SEO/AEO/GEO measurement that connects visibility and engagement with conversion and organic pipeline outcomes.
Evolve Varicent’s approach to discoverability across traditional search engines, AI-powered search experiences, review sites, citations, and third-party platforms.

Digital Analytics, Attribution & Performance

Own the digital performance measurement framework across paid media, SEO/AEO/GEO, website experience, and conversion paths.
Define KPIs, dashboards, reporting cadences, and executive-level performance narratives.
Partner with Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Analytics to ensure reliable campaign tracking, attribution, data flow, lead capture, routing, scoring, and reporting.
Analyze performance across the funnel, including traffic quality, engagement, conversion, MQL and opportunity creation, pipeline contribution, and ROI.
Translate complex performance data into clear insights and recommendations for senior leadership.
Lead digital forecasting and performance planning in partnership with Demand Generation and revenue teams.
Build a test-and-learn culture that continuously improves audiences, creative, messaging, website experiences, and investment decisions.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead and develop the digital marketing and web experience function, including a Senior Web Developer and Senior Manager of Digital Marketing, alongside Varicent’s SEO/AEO/GEO and paid media agency partners.
Set clear goals, responsibilities, performance expectations, development plans, and operating rhythms for two direct reports.
Build a culture of accountability, creativity, speed, experimentation, and measurable impact.
Manage team capacity, prioritization, workload, hiring needs, and career development.
Coach team members to strengthen strategic thinking, execution quality, and analytical decision-making.
Establish scalable processes for campaign execution, web intake, design review, QA, testing, and agency collaboration.
Shape the future-state organization, including team structure, capability gaps, and development needs.

Agency, Vendor & Budget Management

Own digital marketing and web budget planning across paid media, agencies, contractors, tools, and platforms.
Manage external partners across paid media, SEO, web design and development, analytics, creative production, and CRO.
Define agency scopes, deliverables, timelines, performance expectations, and accountability.
Evaluate agency and vendor performance and make recommendations regarding renewals, consolidation, replacement, or additional investment.
Develop business cases for digital investments based on growth opportunities, performance, and expected ROI.
Partner with Finance, Procurement, Legal, and IT on vendor selection, contracts, renewals, and compliance.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Act as a senior digital and web strategy partner to the SVP of Marketing and broader Marketing leadership team.
Lead alignment across teams on website priorities, digital campaign strategy, conversion goals, investment tradeoffs, and reporting.
Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to understand digital lead quality, pipeline progression, and conversion outcomes.
Partner with Marketing Operations to ensure campaigns have effective tracking, attribution, scoring, and routing.
Collaborate with Product Marketing, Content, Creative, and Brand to create digital experiences that reflect buyer needs, product positioning, and Varicent’s brand.
Communicate priorities, results, risks, investment needs, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

What You’ll Bring

12+ years of experience across digital marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, web strategy, or performance marketing, gained in-house, at an agency, or through a combination of both.
7+ years of people leadership experience, including leading teams, managers, or multidisciplinary digital and web functions.
Significant B2B marketing experience, ideally within SaaS, technology, enterprise software, or another complex sales environment.
A track record of building and scaling digital strategies that contribute to measurable pipeline, revenue, and efficient customer acquisition.
Deep knowledge of paid media, SEM, SEO, paid social, display, retargeting, programmatic, content syndication, and account-based advertising.
Strong understanding of website strategy, UX, web design and development workflows, CMS management, CRO, accessibility, and web analytics.
Experience leading website redesigns, optimization programs, landing page strategies, or other significant digital experience initiatives.
Experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks, or similar technologies.
Experience with CMS platforms such as HubSpot, WordPress, Webflow, Drupal, Adobe Experience Manager, or similar.
Understanding of marketing automation, CRM, attribution, campaign tracking, lead management, and funnel reporting using platforms such as Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot, Looker, or Power BI.
Experience managing significant paid media budgets and reallocating investment based on performance.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn complex data into clear business insights and recommendations.
Experience managing agencies, vendors, contractors, scopes of work, budgets, and performance expectations.
Executive-level communication skills and experience presenting strategy, results, risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Strong cross-functional and program leadership skills, with the ability to navigate competing priorities across teams, systems, agencies, and timelines.
Experience incorporating AI-powered marketing capabilities, such as generative AI, AI-driven personalization, or conversational experiences, into the digital marketing ecosystem.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Security & IT
jobs.description:
At
Klue
, We’re Building the Future of Competitive Intelligence

We’re looking for a Security, Compliance & IT Leader 👋

As our Director, Enterprise Security & IT
, you'll sit at the intersection of security, compliance, and IT operations. You'll be accountable for how Klue protects customer data and how every Kluebee gets equipped to do their best work. Today, these three areas sit under different teams. You'll turn them into one team with one roadmap, working alongside an Engineering org that already builds and runs our product infrastructure.

Your Mission?
To own the security and compliance posture that our customers, our sales team, and our own people rely on. That covers everything we do: from building the product, to the internal automations, to the tools we use, and how we use AI. You'll set the standard, build the systems and set the rhythm to meet it. And in the process, make the secure way, the easy way.

What's In It for You?

You won't inherit a playbook. You'll write it. You'll define the operating model, the culture, and the technical direction for a brand-new function, and shape a small, sharp team of 2 from day one. You'll report directly to the CTO and work closely with the Senior Leadership Team, as well as the Engineering, Product, Sales, and People teams. You'll tackle big questions like how to govern AI agents connected to company systems, and your answers will set policy at Klue. As Klue grows, so do the team and your scope. You have the power to shape what that looks like.

What You'll Do

Own security posture and incident readiness. Mature how Klue prevents, detects, and responds to security issues. Design the incident response process and governance, and make sure everyone knows their role before something goes wrong.
Run the compliance engine. Own the annual audit cycle against SOC 2 Type II, NIST CSF, and BSIMM, plus penetration testing, from evidence collection to a successful finish. Build audit methodology and documentation that make reviews faster and less painful for the whole company.
Be the security answer for go-to-market. Keep customer questionnaires, external assessments, and audits moving on time. Review and negotiate data protection agreements and security exhibits with customers and vendors so what we sign matches what we do.
Govern vendors, data, and privacy. Run full-spectrum vendor reviews, including sub-processor qualification. Own DLP, data retention, and the privacy framework for an international customer base, including data subject access requests.
Set the rules for AI and high-risk access. Own AI security governance: policies, risk acceptance, data handling, and permissioning for AI tools, agents, and integrations connected to company systems. Define and enforce access governance for high-risk systems, including admin access reviews, service accounts vs. individual credentials, and controls on sensitive logs and data.
Make security engineering's job easier. Set the security and compliance standard for Engineering's security work. Give the team the tooling, policy, and guidelines to build against, and translate their technical work into terms leadership and customers can act on.
Equip and enable every Kluebee. Own devices, access, and tooling across the full employee lifecycle. Manage the vendors behind our IT stack, set and hit reliability targets (SLOs) for corporate systems, and replace ad hoc fixes with repeatable processes that scale. Partner with People so onboarding and offboarding run smoothly. (Product infrastructure stays with Engineering.)

What Success Looks Like

One team, one roadmap. Within two quarters, Security, Compliance, and IT operate as one team with a shared roadmap and a regular operating rhythm.
Customers get fast, consistent answers. Questionnaires, audits, and sub-processor reviews are completed on time and in a repeatable way.
AI and access are governed, not improvised. High-risk systems and AI tools are covered by clear, documented policy, and admin access reviews are routine, not reactive.
Corporate systems are reliable. You define clear SLOs in your first quarter, and Klue meets or beats them.
We're ready when it counts. Incident response governance is documented and understood, and Engineering's security engineers have the tooling and guidelines to respond fast.
Day 1 just works. Every new Kluebee has working equipment and access on their first day, with no scrambling.
The budget is a set of clear choices. You actively manage the function's budget and make defensible tradeoffs between tooling, vendors, and headcount.
You're the default owner. The CTO and SLT turn to you for security, compliance, and IT. Engineering and GTM teams see you as the partner who makes their job easier, not another layer to work around.

What You Bring

Must Haves

You've run security and compliance at a company handling sensitive customer data. You're comfortable owning DLP, data retention, and privacy frameworks, and you can work through a security questionnaire or audit without panic.
You've led IT operations for a whole company, covering equipment, access, and tooling.
You know security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST) and global privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in depth.
You're comfortable with ambiguity and building without a playbook.
You communicate clearly with both technical peers and non-technical leaders, and can explain a risk to an engineer and to a CEO.
You've negotiated data protection agreements and security exhibits in vendor and customer contracts.
You understand AI security and governance: data retention commitments, access and permissioning for AI agents and integrations, and risk acceptance for AI tooling.
You've worked closely with product and engineering teams to turn security and compliance goals into reality.

Nice-to-Haves

You've owned a DevOps and/or security engineering function inside a larger engineering org.
You've brought previously siloed security, compliance, and IT teams together under one roof.
You know privacy and data residency frameworks for an international customer base.
You've managed distributed or hybrid teams.

jobs.description:
First Nations and Indigenous Organizations

Position:
Finance Director

Organization:
Keepers of the Circle / Temiskaming Native Women's Support Group

Location:
In person. Temiskaming Shores, Northern Ontario

Position Type: Full-Time
Salary Range: $93,600–$124,800, depending on experience
Reports To: Executive Director
Date Posted: September 29, 2026
Closing Date: October 13, 2026

Position Summary

The Keepers of the Circle Finance Director will provide strategic leadership, stewardship, and oversight of all financial operations for our Indigenous led, not-for-profit organization.

This role ensures financial integrity, sustainability, accountability, and compliance with funder requirements while supporting the organization’s mission, values, and commitment to Indigenous community well-being, cultural integrity, and self-determination. The Finance Director will work closely with senior leadership, Board of Directors, Finance department, program managers, government funders, and external auditors.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Financial Leadership

Lead all financial operations, including budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and financial reporting.
Provide strategic financial insights to the Executive Director, Leadership Team, and Board to support evidence-based decision-making.
Strengthen financial systems, internal controls, and organizational financial resilience.
Support long-term financial planning, scenario modelling, and risk mitigation strategies.

Financial Operations & Compliance

Oversee day-to-day accounting, payroll, fund accounting, and financial controls.
Ensure compliance with Indigenous Services Canada (ISC), provincial ministries, federal funders, and other grant requirements.
Lead annual audit processes and ensure adherence to GAAP or ASNPO standards.
Maintain accurate, timely financial statements and funder reports.

Funding, Grants & Restricted Contributions

Oversee reporting for grants, contribution agreements, restricted funding, and multi-year funding streams.
Support program teams with budget development, financial tracking, and funder reporting.
Distinguish secured funding from future opportunities and ensure transparent tracking.

Leadership & Collaboration

Lead and mentor finance staff, fostering accountability, high performance, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with Indigenous partners, advisory councils, and community stakeholders to ensure culturally grounded financial practices.
Support organizational planning, staffing decisions, and investment strategies.

Operational Oversight

Maintain financial systems (e.g., QuickBooks, Sage 300, ERP systems) and administrative processes.
Oversee contracts, procurement, and risk management frameworks.
Liaise with auditors, legal counsel, and external financial advisors.

Qualifications & Requirements

Education & Credentials

CPA designation required or in progress
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience

7–10 years of progressive financial management experience, including senior leadership roles.
Experience working with Indigenous organizations, First Nations governments, Tribal Councils, or Indigenous led not-for-profits strongly preferred.
Experience with project-based accounting, funder reporting, budgeting, payroll oversight, and audits.
Knowledge of ISC funding agreements, provincial funding streams, and federal contribution agreements considered an asset.

Technical Skills

Proficiency with accounting systems (QuickBooks Online, Sage 300, ERP platforms).
Advanced Excel skills and strong financial modelling capabilities.
Knowledge of ASNPO standards preferred.

Cultural & Organizational Competencies

Demonstrated commitment to Indigenous cultural safety, reconciliation, and respectful engagement.
Ability to work collaboratively in a mission-driven, community-focused environment.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate financial information into clear, actionable insights.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary range: $93,600–$124,800
Comprehensive benefits package
Generous paid vacation, sick time, and personal days.
Opportunities for professional development, Indigenous cultural learning, and leadership growth.

How To Apply

Please submit your cover letter, resume, and three professional references to:

careers@keepersofthecircle.com Subject Line: (Name) Finance Director Application

Please mention you saw this at GoodWork.ca
.

Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

The Opportunity

Varicent is seeking a strategic, creative, and data-driven Director, Digital Marketing & Web Experience
to lead our digital growth engine across digital marketing, website strategy and experience, paid media, SEO/AEO/GEO, conversion optimization, and digital performance measurement.

This leader will own the strategy and performance of Varicent’s digital channels, with accountability for their contribution to pipeline and revenue. You’ll shape how prospective customers discover, engage with, and convert through Varicent’s digital experiences while ensuring our investments are measurable, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.

This is a broad functional leadership role that combines strategic ownership with operational fluency. You’ll lead a team and agency ecosystem spanning digital marketing and web experience while partnering closely with Marketing leadership, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Content, Creative, Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Marketing, IT, Finance, and other stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

Digital Marketing Strategy & Leadership

Own Varicent’s digital marketing strategy across paid media, SEO/SEM, website experience, landing pages, conversion optimization, retargeting, and account-based digital programs.
Develop and lead a multi-quarter digital marketing and web roadmap aligned with pipeline, revenue, brand, and customer acquisition goals.
Define the role of digital channels throughout the buyer journey, from awareness and demand creation through conversion, pipeline acceleration, and customer expansion.
Establish priorities, investment areas, operating rhythms, and measurement frameworks for the function.
Identify emerging digital opportunities, buyer behavior shifts, platform changes, competitive trends, and technologies that can improve performance.
Serve as the senior functional leader for digital marketing and web experience across the Marketing organization.

Paid Media, Digital Acquisition & Pipeline

Own strategy and performance across paid digital channels, including Google Ads, LinkedIn, paid social, display, retargeting, review sites, content syndication, programmatic, ABM platforms, and intent-based advertising.
Own paid media budget strategy, channel mix, investment allocation, forecasting, and spend pacing.
Partner with agencies on campaign execution, optimization, reporting, and performance recommendations.
Partner with Demand Generation, Content, and Product Marketing to develop digital programs supporting product, audience, industry, ABM, event, webinar, and pipeline acceleration initiatives.
Lead audience segmentation, targeting, and experimentation across channels, creative, landing pages, forms, CTAs, and conversion paths.
Continuously optimize programs to improve conversion, lead quality, opportunity creation, pipeline contribution, and return on marketing investment.
Ensure digital programs are effectively integrated with marketing automation, CRM, lead routing, scoring, nurture, attribution, and reporting.

Website Strategy & Digital Experience

Own Varicent’s corporate website strategy as a core demand generation, brand, product storytelling, and conversion platform.
Lead the vision for website experience, UX, design, navigation, information architecture, conversion paths, accessibility, and brand consistency in partnership with the Senior Web Developer.
Own the website roadmap and establish effective processes for prioritization, governance, design standards, development coordination, QA, and release management.
Lead the strategy for landing pages, campaign pages, product and industry pages, resource experiences, demo request paths, and event pages.
Partner with Brand, Creative, Content, and Product Marketing to ensure the website clearly communicates Varicent’s value proposition and differentiation.
Drive conversion rate optimization through analytics, heatmaps, behavioral insights, A/B testing, and funnel performance data.
Ensure the website is optimized for search visibility, accessibility, Core Web Vitals, mobile responsiveness, privacy, security, and performance.
Lead major digital experience initiatives, including redesigns, CMS improvements, migrations, personalization programs, and other website transformations.

Organic Search & Discoverability

Own Varicent’s SEO strategy and ensure paid and organic search work together to maximize visibility, efficiency, and conversion.
Partner with the Senior Manager of Digital Marketing to identify keyword opportunities, content gaps, high-intent buyer topics, and organic growth priorities.
Guide technical SEO, content optimization, site architecture, metadata, schema, internal linking, and search-focused website improvements.
Partner with the Senior Web Developer and agencies to resolve technical SEO issues related to indexing, crawlability, redirects, site speed, and page structure.
Establish SEO/AEO/GEO measurement that connects visibility and engagement with conversion and organic pipeline outcomes.
Evolve Varicent’s approach to discoverability across traditional search engines, AI-powered search experiences, review sites, citations, and third-party platforms.

Digital Analytics, Attribution & Performance

Own the digital performance measurement framework across paid media, SEO/AEO/GEO, website experience, and conversion paths.
Define KPIs, dashboards, reporting cadences, and executive-level performance narratives.
Partner with Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Analytics to ensure reliable campaign tracking, attribution, data flow, lead capture, routing, scoring, and reporting.
Analyze performance across the funnel, including traffic quality, engagement, conversion, MQL and opportunity creation, pipeline contribution, and ROI.
Translate complex performance data into clear insights and recommendations for senior leadership.
Lead digital forecasting and performance planning in partnership with Demand Generation and revenue teams.
Build a test-and-learn culture that continuously improves audiences, creative, messaging, website experiences, and investment decisions.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead and develop the digital marketing and web experience function, including a Senior Web Developer and Senior Manager of Digital Marketing, alongside Varicent’s SEO/AEO/GEO and paid media agency partners.
Set clear goals, responsibilities, performance expectations, development plans, and operating rhythms for two direct reports.
Build a culture of accountability, creativity, speed, experimentation, and measurable impact.
Manage team capacity, prioritization, workload, hiring needs, and career development.
Coach team members to strengthen strategic thinking, execution quality, and analytical decision-making.
Establish scalable processes for campaign execution, web intake, design review, QA, testing, and agency collaboration.
Shape the future-state organization, including team structure, capability gaps, and development needs.

Agency, Vendor & Budget Management

Own digital marketing and web budget planning across paid media, agencies, contractors, tools, and platforms.
Manage external partners across paid media, SEO, web design and development, analytics, creative production, and CRO.
Define agency scopes, deliverables, timelines, performance expectations, and accountability.
Evaluate agency and vendor performance and make recommendations regarding renewals, consolidation, replacement, or additional investment.
Develop business cases for digital investments based on growth opportunities, performance, and expected ROI.
Partner with Finance, Procurement, Legal, and IT on vendor selection, contracts, renewals, and compliance.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Act as a senior digital and web strategy partner to the SVP of Marketing and broader Marketing leadership team.
Lead alignment across teams on website priorities, digital campaign strategy, conversion goals, investment tradeoffs, and reporting.
Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to understand digital lead quality, pipeline progression, and conversion outcomes.
Partner with Marketing Operations to ensure campaigns have effective tracking, attribution, scoring, and routing.
Collaborate with Product Marketing, Content, Creative, and Brand to create digital experiences that reflect buyer needs, product positioning, and Varicent’s brand.
Communicate priorities, results, risks, investment needs, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

What You’ll Bring

12+ years of experience across digital marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, web strategy, or performance marketing, gained in-house, at an agency, or through a combination of both.
7+ years of people leadership experience, including leading teams, managers, or multidisciplinary digital and web functions.
Significant B2B marketing experience, ideally within SaaS, technology, enterprise software, or another complex sales environment.
A track record of building and scaling digital strategies that contribute to measurable pipeline, revenue, and efficient customer acquisition.
Deep knowledge of paid media, SEM, SEO, paid social, display, retargeting, programmatic, content syndication, and account-based advertising.
Strong understanding of website strategy, UX, web design and development workflows, CMS management, CRO, accessibility, and web analytics.
Experience leading website redesigns, optimization programs, landing page strategies, or other significant digital experience initiatives.
Experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks, or similar technologies.
Experience with CMS platforms such as HubSpot, WordPress, Webflow, Drupal, Adobe Experience Manager, or similar.
Understanding of marketing automation, CRM, attribution, campaign tracking, lead management, and funnel reporting using platforms such as Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot, Looker, or Power BI.
Experience managing significant paid media budgets and reallocating investment based on performance.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn complex data into clear business insights and recommendations.
Experience managing agencies, vendors, contractors, scopes of work, budgets, and performance expectations.
Executive-level communication skills and experience presenting strategy, results, risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Strong cross-functional and program leadership skills, with the ability to navigate competing priorities across teams, systems, agencies, and timelines.
Experience incorporating AI-powered marketing capabilities, such as generative AI, AI-driven personalization, or conversational experiences, into the digital marketing ecosystem.

, with a clear focus on generating pipeline and supporting revenue growth.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the function — leading a Senior Manager of Digital Marketing and Senior Web Developer
, partnering with specialized agencies, and working closely with senior leaders across Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, Content, Creative, and Finance.

What You’ll Do

Own Our Digital Growth Strategy

Set the strategy and roadmap across paid media, website experience, SEO/AEO/GEO, conversion optimization, and digital acquisition.
Connect digital investments directly to business goals, including pipeline, revenue, customer acquisition, and brand growth.
Identify new opportunities across buyer behavior, emerging channels, AI-powered search, personalization, and digital experiences.
Bring together teams, agencies, technology, and data around clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

Turn Our Website Into a Growth Engine

Own the strategy for Varicent.com as a key demand generation, storytelling, and conversion platform.
Partner closely with our Senior Web Developer to evolve the website experience, UX, navigation, performance, accessibility, and conversion paths.
Use analytics, behavioral insights, A/B testing, and experimentation to continuously improve the buyer journey.
Lead major web initiatives such as redesigns, personalization, CMS improvements, and other digital experience programs.

Drive Digital Acquisition & Discoverability

Lead our paid media strategy across search, social, retargeting, ABM, programmatic, and other digital channels.
Own channel mix, budget allocation, forecasting, and optimization based on performance.
Shape Varicent’s approach to SEO, AEO, and GEO, helping buyers discover us across both traditional and AI-powered search experiences.
Partner with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, and Content to translate campaigns into effective digital experiences.

Make Data Actionable

Define how we measure digital performance across traffic, engagement, conversion, opportunities, pipeline, and ROI.
Partner with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations to strengthen tracking, attribution, lead flow, and reporting.
Turn performance data into clear recommendations on where to optimize, experiment, and invest.
Build a culture of testing and continuous improvement across channels, audiences, creative, and web experiences.

Lead & Build

Lead and develop a Senior Manager of Digital Marketing and Senior Web Developer, alongside our paid media and SEO/AEO/GEO agency partners.
Create clear priorities and operating rhythms that allow the team to move quickly without sacrificing quality.
Own digital marketing and web budgets, agency relationships, tools, and investments.
Serve as a trusted digital strategy partner to the SVP of Marketing and broader Marketing leadership team.
Help shape how the digital and web function evolves as Varicent grows.

What You’ll Bring

We’re looking for a digital leader who has operated in a B2B SaaS, technology, enterprise software, or similarly complex sales environment
and understands how digital experiences translate into business growth.

You’ll Likely Bring

12+ years of experience across digital marketing, growth, demand generation, performance marketing, or web strategy.
7+ years of people leadership experience, including leading multidisciplinary teams or managers.
Experience owning digital strategy with measurable responsibility for pipeline, revenue, conversion, and customer acquisition.
Deep knowledge of paid media, SEO/SEM, digital acquisition, web strategy, CRO, analytics, and experimentation.
Experience owning or significantly influencing a B2B website and understanding how UX, content, technology, and conversion work together.
Experience managing meaningful digital budgets and making investment decisions based on performance.
Strong analytical instincts and the ability to turn complex data into clear recommendations.
Experience leading agencies and external partners while maintaining strong internal ownership.
The ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and connect digital strategy to broader company goals.
Comfort working in a growth-oriented environment where priorities evolve and leaders are expected to both set direction and help move the work forward.
Familiarity with tools such as HubSpot, Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Salesforce, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, ABM platforms, experimentation tools, and modern analytics platforms.
An understanding of how AI is changing digital marketing, content discovery, personalization, and the buyer journey.

Nice to Have

Experience with HubSpot CMS, ABM and intent platforms, multi-touch attribution, website personalization, CRO platforms, behavioral analytics, major website redesigns or migrations, and global digital programs
is a plus.

Working knowledge of HTML/CSS and familiarity with accessibility, privacy, Core Web Vitals, and web governance will also help you partner effectively with our web team.

In your first few months, you’ll get to know our digital ecosystem, team, agencies, performance, and buyers; identify where we can improve quickly; and establish clear priorities for digital growth.

From there, you’ll build a multi-quarter roadmap, strengthen how we measure digital contribution to pipeline and revenue, establish a structured experimentation approach, and evolve Varicent’s website into an even stronger growth and conversion engine.

Over time, success will mean better digital experiences, stronger organic visibility, smarter media investment, higher conversion, clearer performance insights, and measurable growth in digital-sourced pipeline
— supported by a team and operating model that can scale with Varicent.
